cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files that we store in your browser so that Tendrik.sk works and so that we can understand it.

whatWeUse.heading: Which cookies we use
whatWeUse.consent: <0>Cookie consent</0> – remembers your choice from this banner.
whatWeUse.analyticsItem: Anonymized visit statistics (Plausible / GA4) – only if you allow them.
whatWeUse.noMarketing: We do not use marketing or advertising cookies.

howToDisable.heading: How to disable cookies
howToDisable.intro: You can change your choice at any time:
howToDisable.viaButton: Via the <0>Cookie settings</0> button in the page footer or here:
howToDisable.viaBrowser: In your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge…).
howToDisable.cannotDisable: Necessary cookies cannot be disabled – without them logging in would not be possible.

retention.heading: Retention period
retention.session: Session cookie: until the browser is closed.
retention.consentAnalytics: Consent and analytical cookies: max. 24 months.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Effective from 1 January 2026. These terms govern the use of the Tendrik.sk service.

s1.heading: 1. Operator
s1.p: The operator of the Tendrik.sk service (hereinafter the „Service") is the company:
s1.seat: Registered office: Športová 707/43, 919 26 Zavar, Slovak Republic
s1.vatNote: The company <0>is not a VAT payer</0>; the prices listed on Tendrik.sk are final.

s2.heading: 2. Description of the service
s2.p: Tendrik.sk is an online SaaS platform that automatically monitors public procurement notices published in the Official Journal of the EU (TED) and in the bulletin of the Slovak Public Procurement Office (ÚVO). It allows users to:
s2.item1: filter contracts by keywords, CPV codes, countries and regions,
s2.item2: receive e-mail notifications about new contracts and upcoming deadlines,
s2.item3: view contract details with a link to the source (TED / ÚVO / EKS / JOSEPHINE).

s3.heading: 3. Price and payment terms
s3.p: Use of the Service is subject to a flat monthly fee according to the selected tier:
s3.vatNote: The supplier <0>Tobify s. r. o.</0> is not a VAT payer – the amounts listed are final.
s3.payment: Payment is made via the <0>GoPay</0> payment gateway by payment card (Visa, Mastercard) secured with 3D Secure. The subscription automatically renews every month; more information in the <1>Recurring Payments</1> document.

s4.heading: 4. Trial period
s4.text: A new user receives <0>30 days free</0> from registration, without needing to enter a payment card. The trial includes unlimited monitoring, radars and e-mails, and<1> 5 complete AI contract analyses</1> during the trial. After the trial period expires, access to paid features is locked until the user activates a paid subscription.

s5.heading: 5. Conclusion of the contract
s5.text: The contract between the Operator and the user arises at the moment the order is confirmed (payment activation) in the user interface. The user confirms that they have read and agree to these terms.

s6.heading: 6. Withdrawal from the contract (14 days)
s6.text: The consumer has the right to withdraw from a distance contract within <0>14 days</0> without giving a reason, pursuant to § 7 of Act No. 102/2014 Coll. Withdrawal must be sent to the e-mail <1>info@tendrik.sk</1>. If the Service has already been provided within this period with the consumer's consent, a proportional part of the price will be refunded.

s7.heading: 7. Cancellation and termination of the subscription
s7.text: The subscription can be cancelled <0>at any time</0> in the account settings or by e-mail to <1>info@tendrik.sk</1>. After cancellation, the subscription will not be automatically renewed. <2>The balance of the already paid period is not refunded</2> (except in the case under point 6 or a successful complaint).

s8.heading: 8. Complaints procedure
s8.text: We accept complaints by e-mail at <0>info@tendrik.sk</0> or by post to the registered office address. We will handle the complaint no later than <1>30 days</1> from its receipt. Details can be found in the <2>Complaints Procedure</2>.

s9.heading: 9. Responsibility for content
s9.text: Contract data comes from public sources TED, ÚVO, EKS and JOSEPHINE. The Operator is not responsible for the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of this source data. Use of the results is at the user's own risk.

s10.heading: 10. Personal data protection
s10.text: The processing of personal data is governed by a separate document, <0>GDPR – Personal Data Protection</0>.

s11.heading: 11. Dispute resolution
s11.text: Any disputes are resolved primarily by agreement. The consumer has the right to contact the Slovak Trade Inspection (<0>soi.sk</0>) or use the ODR platform: <1>ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr</1>.

s12.heading: 12. Final provisions
s12.text: The Operator reserves the right to change these terms. Users will be informed of material changes by e-mail at least 15 days in advance. Relationships not governed by these terms are governed by the laws of the Slovak Republic.

recurringPayments.title: Recurring Payments
recurringPayments.intro: The Tendrik subscription is paid via automatic monthly payments through the GoPay payment gateway.

summary.amount: 💳 Amount: <0>€4.99 / month</0> (Basic) or <1>€14.99 / month</1> (Premium) – final price
summary.trial: 🎁 <0>30 days free</0> to try (trial period, including 5 AI analyses)
summary.cancel: ❌ Cancel anytime in the account settings

s1.heading: What are recurring payments
s1.text: A recurring payment is an automatic card payment that is charged at regular intervals without you having to confirm the payment each time. You authorize the first payment when activating the subscription; subsequent payments are made automatically based on a token from the secure <0>GoPay</0> payment gateway.

s2.heading: Payment amount
s2.vatNote: The supplier (Tobify s. r. o.) is not a VAT payer – the amounts listed are final.
s2.changeNotice: We will inform you of any price change by e-mail at least 15 days in advance.

s3.heading: When the payment is charged
s3.first: <0>First payment:</0> after the end of the 2-month trial period, or upon activation of the subscription.
s3.next: <0>Subsequent payments:</0> every month on the day corresponding to the activation date.
s3.invoice: We will send you an e-mail with a tax document before each payment.

s4.heading: How to cancel payments
s4.intro: You can cancel recurring payments at any time in two ways:
s4.way1: In <0>account settings</0> on Tendrik.sk by clicking „Cancel subscription".
s4.way2: By e-mail to <0>info@tendrik.sk</0> from the e-mail address the account is registered under.
s4.afterCancel: After cancellation, no further payment will be charged to your card. Access to paid features remains available until the end of the current billing period.

s5.heading: Payment security
s5.text: Payment card data is processed exclusively by the payment gateway <0>GoPay s. r. o.</0> in accordance with <1>PCI-DSS Level 1</1>. Tendrik never has access to your card number or CVV code; only an anonymized token needed for recurring charges is stored. Payments are protected by <2>3D Secure</2> authentication.

privacy.title: Personal Data Protection
privacy.intro: Tendrik is a service for entrepreneurs (30 days free, then from €4.99/month). We process personal data only to the extent necessary for the service to function.

dataSection.heading: What data we process
dataSection.text: Upon registration, we store your e-mail address and notification settings (radars, e-mail frequency, saved contracts). We use the data exclusively to deliver the service.

cookiesSection.heading: Cookies
cookiesSection.intro: We use two categories of cookies:
cookiesSection.necessary: <0>Necessary</0> – required for login, session and basic settings. Without them the site cannot function.
cookiesSection.analytics: <0>Analytical</0> – optional. They are loaded only if you give consent. They help us measure the use of the service.

rightsSection.heading: Your rights
rightsSection.text: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. If you have any questions, contact us at the e-mail address stated in the application.
